cohort: 130 women who underwent lower caesarean section at Sir Salimullah Medical College & Mitford Hospital, Dhaka, Bangladesh
finding: The study found a high incidence of cesarean section, with repeat cesarean section being the most common indication, and no maternal mortality.
mod_finding: Out of 130 caesarean sections, 80 (61.5%) were emergency and 50 (38.5%) were elective.
